criteria.test: FE-A1.3-W01-AC01 critical: hashed foreign context and fabricated intake evidence are rejected
criteria.observation: A validly hashed context from another Project is rejected before retention and before invocation; cross-Project context and fabricated source reports cannot acquire advisory authority.

criteria.test: FE-A1.3-W01-AC02 critical: editing the fixed synthesis question cannot borrow its authority
criteria.observation: An altered fixed synthesis question is denied at the production route before the provider receives a turn.

criteria.test: FE-A1.3-W01-AC03 critical: tool activity model substitution and invented source wording fail
criteria.observation: Changed deployed core bytes withhold readiness before provider access or repository recovery; prohibited tools, model substitution, uncited reports and invented authority are rejected. Partial ordinary bodies, editable command arguments, arbitrary tools and fabricated approval/receipt fields are rejected by the registered human decision contract. Typed activity transport preserves native origin/Work/Run identities and refuses Actor overrides or completed output under failed delivery.

boundary: Conversation and explicit human-decision contract boundary checks. Actual model eligibility, canonical proposal ownership, ordinary command effects, visible chat and Workspace convergence require their separate prerequisite and command-bridge items.

review.perspective: Attempt cross-Project retention and model invocation, fixed-role authority borrowing, deployment drift, prohibited tools and fabricated evidence rather than repeat the successful conversation.
